note: Fixed list of current supported tool workflows plus four explicit gaps. Every operation counts once. Ready requires evidenced contract, enabled integration and relevant output validation, with no blocker. This is not all engine behavior or all possible file variants. Historical validated workflows form the baseline, not new cycle gains. A changed feature list requires a new scope/version and a disclosed delta.
deferred: Complete original engine/game startup, renderer and shader compiler
PS2 file writing and platform-specific GPU backend
Unrequested camera/morph/event export, PMX reference import and arbitrary MMD rigs

features.title: Открытие и просмотр моделей/уровней
features.acceptance: Open supported PC SMO, resolve mesh/material/texture/placement links and display the expected geometry using the shared renderer.
limits: Supported decoded mesh/material forms; this is not exact emulation of every native game effect.

features.title: Просмотр SAN-анимации на модели
features.acceptance: Select supported SAN, bind case-sensitive bone names, sample time and apply skin/inverse-bind transforms to the displayed model.
limits: Supported key encodings and rig bindings; game events and actor scheduling excluded.

features.title: Экспорт геометрии и размещений GLB/OBJ/FBX
features.acceptance: Export supported scene geometry/materials and instance or baked placements, then read the target representation with expected counts and transforms.
limits: OBJ has no skin/animation or native instancing; documented unsupported alpha/effect combinations remain explicit, including the separate FBX-alpha operation below.

features.title: Экспорт skin и SAN в GLB/FBX
features.acceptance: Preserve supported skeleton, palettes, weights, inverse binds and animation tracks in rigged GLB/FBX export.
limits: No unknown events, morphs or game physics; supported material combinations only.

features.title: Импорт rigid-модели OBJ/GLB/FBX
features.acceptance: Import supported static geometry, UV/material/texture data and produce a structurally valid SMO accepted in the relevant PC scene.
limits: Existing documented format, memory, vertex/index and material bounds.

features.title: Импорт skinned-модели
features.acceptance: Map the supported donor/target rig, write weights/palettes/reference order and validate the resulting deformation in the applicable native scene.
limits: Documented target-rig matching rules; unknown weighted bones remain explicit errors.

features.title: Перемещение и управление экземплярами уровня
features.acceptance: Transform, duplicate, add or remove supported placements while preserving shared resources and correct world/local transforms in saved output.
limits: Supported authored placements; arbitrary extraction of baked partition geometry is a separate future operation.

features.title: Редактирование коллизии уровня
features.acceptance: Add, transform, link/unlink, regenerate and remove the supported collision branch with correct group/face/reference semantics and relevant gameplay acceptance.
limits: Supported mesh/BV production path; no promise to recreate the entire collision engine or navigation.

features.title: Проект → сборка SMO → повторное открытие
features.acceptance: Save/reopen the current project schema, build deterministically, preserve untouched payloads and references, and validate atomic output and applicable native scene loading.
limits: Current project schema and supported edits; no migration of arbitrary older project versions.

features.title: Просмотр и извлечение текстур в PNG
features.acceptance: List and decode the supported embedded texture slots, inspect channels and export their image pixels through the GUI.
limits: Current supported embedded texture variants; not all PC/PS2 texture layouts.

features.title: Замена текстуры через Importer/редактор
features.acceptance: Replace a supported fixed-size texture slot with the declared RGB/alpha policy, preserving unrelated bytes and producing accepted native output.
limits: Only slots identified by the supported writer; unknown texture forms remain unchanged.

features.title: Замена текстуры в GUI TextureTool
features.acceptance: Enable selection and fixed-dimension replacement of supported textures in TextureTool, save a copy through the corrected writer, and verify actual output structure/pixels/native acceptance.
limits: Explicit RGB/alpha policy and supported embedded texture forms; no material-blend inference.

features.title: Изменение размеров и repack в TextureTool
features.acceptance: Preserve supplied replacement dimensions for supported textures, update real serializer/container sizes and references, expose the operation in GUI and validate resized output through the original reader.
limits: Bounded dimensions/formats and declared native normalization behavior; unsupported records remain unchanged.

features.title: FBX: совместная alpha текстуры и материала
features.acceptance: Export the currently rejected combination of texture alpha and non-unit material alpha without losing their combined opacity, and validate the target FBX result.
limits: Supported blend materials; target-format constraints must be stated rather than silently approximated.

features.title: SAN → VMD для поддерживаемых PMD
features.acceptance: Convert supported SAN/SMO rigs to the documented PMD reference profiles; independent VMD reading and pose checks confirm the declared bone-motion mapping.
limits: Documented PMD rigs/channels; excludes PMX, arbitrary rigs, game events/physics, visual mesh-fit guarantee and VMD scale channels.

features.title: Редкие SAN-ключи в конвертере
features.acceptance: Decode the currently unsupported packed cubic and scalar-rotation key representations for required channels, validate sampling against original behavior and produce equivalent supported VMD motion.
limits: Does not make inherently unrepresentable VMD scale channels supported.
